phaseFinding.entryEvidence: EventReceived wrapper copies unused FGameplayEventData at 0x4d5 and invokes 0x3f5; EndTask; 0x415 Current Reinforced branch; 0x436/0x48f original ForceActivateExternalActionAbilityByClass.
phaseFinding.resources: Preserve both original source and release-class heavy activation costs. Read original Current Reinforced; choose reinforced B_Hold or B_Hold_Unreinforced through the existing class branch. Waiting graph has no tick charge or resource mutation.

effects: Read Current Reinforced established by normal heavy activation.
Run existing ForceActivateExternalActionAbilityByClass: reinforced B_Hold or unreinforced B_Hold_Unreinforced, IA_AttackH_Press, priority2.
recipe.resourceProof: Source activation calls B_Hold parent -> BP_HeavyAttack_Base -> Play Heavy Attack Timeline -> Apply Shachi Cost And Endure. Existing release branch performs normal target activation and its normal heavy cost; no resource mutation is inserted, omitted or recomputed by this recipe. Normal waiting bytecode has no tick or resource-attribute modification.
recipe.alreadyReleasedProof: K2Activate initializes Holding=true and Min Duration=false before WaitSInputRelease task activation. OnAlreadyRelease routes to 0x11e -> 0x642 without changing Holding or activating EarlyRelease. OnRelease alone clears Holding and requires Min Duration before early release.
limits: Resource result follows the original success branch at the source activation instant; delayed external combat changes during a hold are intentionally absent.
Blueprint evidence does not establish runtime function dispatch or visual result.
Call once per fresh normally activated source instance; do not invoke on CDO, stale, inactive or unrelated instance.
